scope: Phase 9 Wallet & Ledger Balance Authority Contract
rules: Wallet table columns availableBalance, pendingBalance, lockedBalance MUST equal 0.00 at all times.
Database CHECK constraint Wallet_legacy_balances_zero_check rejects any non-zero value on Wallet.
Canonical balance projections live on LedgerAccount records linked to the Wallet.
A funded wallet fixture MUST create a LedgerAccount with purpose = AVAILABLE, category = LIABILITY (or MERCHANT_PAYABLE), currentBalance = targetAmount.
